item.title: Thrust — via awesome-cpp
item.description: A parallel algorithms library which resembles the C++ Standard Template Library (STL). [Apache2]

item.title: LZMAT — via awesome-cpp
item.description: An extremely fast real-time lossless data compression library. [GPL]

item.title: KArchive — via awesome-cpp
item.description: A library for creating, reading, writing and manipulating file archives like zip and tar. It also provides transparent compression and decompression of data, using formats like gzip, via a subclass of QIODevice. [LGPL]

item.title: Zodiac Engine — via awesome-cpp
item.description: An open-source cross-platform 3D rendering engine and editor (ZEngine) written in C++20 with Vulkan. [MIT]
